scenarios.title: Simic Growth Chamber: it enters tapped and returns a land you control, never an opponent's
instructions: Play Simic Growth Chamber; it enters tapped.
When its trigger resolves, return your Forest to your hand: P2's lands are not offered.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Simic Growth Chamber is tapped, your Forest is in your hand, and P2 keeps its Island.

script.choose: Return Forest to its owner’s hand
